chunks: Al-ʿAlāʾ narrated from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two Imams, peace be upon them, who said:
I asked him about a man who forgot to perform the going between al-Ṣafā and al-Marwah. He said: “It is performed on his behalf.”

key_terms.الصَّفَا: al-Ṣafā, one of the two well-known stations of saʿy
key_terms.الْمَرْوَةِ: al-Marwah, the other station of saʿy
key_terms.يَطُوفَ: to perform the ritual going or circuit here referring to the rite between al-Ṣafā and al-Marwah
key_terms.يُطَافُ عَنْهُ: the rite is performed on his behalf by another

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone forgets the saʿy between Ṣafā and Marwah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about one who forgot the rite between al-Ṣafā and al-Marwah during hajj or ʿumrah. The Imam عليه السلام states that the act may be performed on behalf of the person, indicating deputized fulfillment in this case of forgetfulness.
